Eva's birthday is in July. Anna thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Last Saturday, Anna and Eva went to the hotel. Also, they met at a quiet cafe.
Anna plays badminton with Eva every Saturday. They took many photos at the ticket office. The hotel is one of the best places in the city. Best of all, we picked apples on the farm.
Life is full of small surprises. The weather was sunny that day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the hotel by bike. Best of all, the travel brochure oversold the beach.
Anna hopes to visit Rome one day. Anna learned a lot about music. Anna wants to be a nurse in the future.
